data.content:
## Setup: what the parties exchange

All public data, agreed before any coins move:

- **Amounts** — and which chain each side locks on
- **Time delays** — initiator's refund unlocks ~24 h *after* the responder's (she holds the secret and moves first)
- **Claim pubkeys** — each goes into the hashlock branch of the *other's* contract, so a stolen `S` alone can never sweep the coins
- **Refund pubkeys** — shared so each side can rebuild the counterparty's full redeemScript and audit the on-chain P2SH hash
- **`H = SHA256(S)`** — from the initiator only
data.title: Text Info Node
Random 32 Bytes (Alice secret)
data.comment: ⚠️ NOT a key. Same entropy source, opposite lifecycle — this value gets PUBLISHED on-chain when Alice claims.

# Step 2
- Alice creates tx and sends it to network
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
# Step 3
- Bobs check for tx on chain, verifies locking script and amount (he rebuilds locking script from scratch and compares to that on-chain)
- if everything is right, Bob locks his coins
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
# Step 4
- Alice verifies that Bob's tx is onchain, rebuilds redeemScript (for simplicty we just take Bob's redeemScript in this flow, but Alice has all data to rebuild it), compares to locked tx. If everything is correct, she builds tx which spends Bob's coins.
data.title: Text Info Node

data.content:
# Step 5
- After Bob see Alice has taken his coins, he can take Alice coins, becasue she has revealed the secret as she took his (he should do it in earlier as Alice locktime, otherwise she can claim them back). Bob recreates Alice redeemScript (in this flow for simplictiy we use Alice redeem Script)
